nodes.label: TLS Hardening Configuration
nodes.rationale: SSL protocols restricted to TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 with strong ECDHE/DHE ciphers to prevent insecure negotiations and mitigate vulnerabilities in legacy protocols.

nodes.label: Subject Alternative Name (SAN) Requirement
nodes.rationale: Modern browsers reject self-signed certificates that rely solely on the Common Name (CN) attribute. Mandating SAN ensures trust.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Certificate Rotation
nodes.rationale: Generate certificates as temporary files, validate them, archive pre-existing active certificates with timestamps to a backup/ subfolder, and rename new files to active. This avoids direct file deletion.

nodes.label: Zero-Downtime Nginx Reload
nodes.rationale: Nginx processes reload using SIGHUP or nginx -s reload, gracefully serving existing connections while applying the new certificate configuration without dropping client traffic.

nodes.label: Mixed Content Elimination
nodes.rationale: Using relative paths (/api/v1) for frontend API requests instead of hardcoded HTTP URLs automatically resolves mixed-content blocks when serving react-admin over HTTPS.
